description: Post a notification to macOS Notification Center via osascript. The notification is delivered immediately and follows the calling process's notification settings, and an active Focus such as Do Not Disturb silences it unless that Focus allows the posting app. Title is required; body, subtitle, and sound are optional. Each call creates a new notification (not idempotent).

sound.description: When true, plays the default notification sound. Defaults to false.

name: macos_send_notification

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

success.description: True when the notification was posted successfully.

title: Send macOS Notification
